{{Quote|In accordance with the Bylaws of Independent Systems, a voice vote is required.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>}}
The '''Bylaws of Independent Systems''' were a series of laws that were upheld by the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One such law required a voice vote for the deciding vote on the [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|Confederate–Republic peace initiative]].
